transcribed_by: hand, from the 150 DPI render, cross-checked at 1.8x on three crops (header, left column, right column)
excludes: four handwritten signatures and the rule beneath each, which are not text
caveat: A signature block is genuinely two columns, and the four pairs interleave by y: 'For and on behalf of JICA' and '... of BB' sit on the same line. Transcribed column-wise, left then right, which is how a signature block is read -- but a row-wise reading is defensible, so quote character overlap alongside sequence similarity. This page is the counterpart to real_81_annexure.p0: a real scan, a different producer (Adobe Acrobat Pro 2020 rather than SECnvtToPDF), and Latin rather than Bengali, so it measures the scanner pipeline rather than the script.
